$description: Convenience view of the shadow section of tokens.json. tokens.json remains authoritative. See docs/design-system/elevation.md.

usage.elevation1: Resting card, list item raised on scroll, text field
usage.elevation2: App bar on scroll-under, bottom nav, hovered/pressed card, chip
usage.elevation3: FAB resting, dropdown menu, popover, snackbar
usage.elevation4: Bottom sheet, navigation drawer, FAB pressed

note: Default surface state is flat with a 1px border, not a shadow. Dark mode lightens surfaces (slate-900 -> slate-800) instead of shadowing, with a stronger near-black shadow only for true overlays.
